title: Negative Sobolev regularity and optimal decay for the fractional Navier--Stokes--Poisson system
summary: We establish global well-posedness and sharp higher-order decay estimates for the fractional compressible Navier--Stokes--Poisson system in $\R^{3}$ with fractional Lamé--Navier dissipation $\Lame^αu$ with $α\in[1/2,1]$, and Riesz coupling $Λ^{2β}φ=ρ-\barρ$ with $β\in[0,1]$, where $Λ:=(-Δ)^{1/2}$ and $\barρ>0$ denotes the constant background density. For small perturbations of a constant equilibrium in $H^{Nα}$ with $N\geq3$ and $Nα>5/2$, we prove the global existence and uniqueness of classical solutions.
